tools.label: Typographic arrows:
n.dropwrong1: And what exactly is that supposed to do?
n.typo_done: Yes, yes, you already found that one. Stop rubbing it in.
h.none: No ideas right now. Odd: I usually have too many.
card.ch14.label: Chapter 14
card.ch14.title: The Eraser
end.ch14.title: End of Chapter 14
end.ch14.body:
The Proofreader was the designer's red pen. Now he remembers what "kind" means.
In Chapter 15 the last page gets written.
rule.photo: In the photo on the wall: {}.
page.p41.title: Proofreader's Study — Rules
page.p41.intro: In this study every word has already been corrected. Red corrections are not to be touched.
page.p41.margin: you can still read something under the red. the eraser is at the bottom of the page
page.p42.title: Enclosures for the last page
page.p42.intro: Material to be delivered to the last page of the manual.
page.p42.draft: The designer's pencil draft of the last page: "The end. Thank you for reading the manual. Really, did you read it?"
c.i1: My study. Every word here has already been corrected. In red. Forever.
n.i1: Everything is red. Even the photo on the wall. Who was in the photo?
p.i1: you still have my eraser. look at the arrows at the bottom of the manual: there's an eraser.
n.i2: Page 41: two words corrected in red. Locked. Unless someone erases them.
n.empty2: Nothing there. Everything here is in its place, except the heart.
n.page_wrong: Not on this page. Enclosures go on page 42.
n.tool1: There's nothing to erase there. For once.
n.typo_plate: "Head proofreeder". On his own desk. I'm speechless. No, I'm not: every word correct.
n.typo_diploma: "Corection with honours". The diploma of someone who corrects others. With a typo. Poetry.
n.photo: The photo is covered in red lines. Whoever it was has been "corrected".
c.photo_after: She always kept me behind her ear. Next to the pencil.
n.drawer: The desk drawer. "EMPTY", says page 41. In red.
n.drawer_draft: There's a draft in the drawer. Written in pencil. Take it to the enclosures, page 42.
n.drawer_done: The drawer really is empty now.
n.pen: The giant red pen. The Proofreader is... very proud of it.
c.t1: Every error I don't correct is an error that stays. I can't bear it.
c.t2: Someone once told me that mistakes are how things begin. I don't remember who.
c.kind_tap: Kind. I haven't felt like this since 1996.
n.ph1: Under the red it said "THE DESIGNER". She's in the photo. With a pencil behind her ear.
c.ph1: She was my designer. I was her red pen.
c.ph2: When the game was cancelled, she left. I stayed. Correcting. So as not to think about it.
p.ph1: and i was her pencil. she wrote with me and corrected with you.
c.ph3: So we're... colleagues. What an unpleasant word. What a fitting word.
n.dr1: Under the red: "FULL OF DRAFTS". The drawer opens. There's a sheet written in pencil.
c.dr1: That's her draft of the last page. I never corrected it. I couldn't.
n.draft1: The designer's draft, in the enclosures. The last page already exists. More or less.
p.draft: that's her handwriting. we'll finish it.
c.kind1: "The Proofreader is KIND". ...Yes. I was. I'd forgotten.
p.need_draft: the draft is still missing. the drawer, page 41.
p.need_kind: something is still missing. look at what it says about the designer, on page 41.
c.x1: Very well. The last page will not stay blank.
c.x2: But we'll write it properly. Each in our own colour: the Narrator's black, the Pencil's grey, my red.
n.x1: The Proofreader cooperating. Mark the date.
p.x1: then we'll meet on the last page. all four of us.
c.x3: Five. We won't leave the Hero behind. Even if he always looks backwards.
h.photo.1: The photo on the wall is covered in red lines. On page 41 its description is corrected in red.
h.photo.2: The Pencil lent you her eraser: it's the fourth arrow at the bottom of the manual.
h.photo.3: Drag the eraser onto the red word NOBODY, on page 41.
h.draft.1: The desk drawer has been corrected in red too: "EMPTY".
h.draft.2: Under red corrections there's always something else written.
h.draft.3: Erase EMPTY with the eraser, then drag the draft from the drawer to page 42.
h.kind.1: The Proofreader is INFLEXIBLE. But a new line appeared under the photo.
h.kind.2: What was the designer like? Maybe the Proofreader remembers.
h.kind.3: Swap KIND with INFLEXIBLE, on page 41.
